settings.title: Settings
settings.keysHint: A key is submitted once over HTTPS, stored encrypted server-side, never kept or echoed here; revoke any time.
settings.threadHint: New conversations use the model and approval policy set here. Conversations already open are not affected.

policy.on-request: On request: ask when Codex asks

settings.sandboxHint: Register a model key under Models, then start your cloud sandbox. The first start returns your local link token once.
settings.sandboxCapacityFull: Cloud sandboxes are at capacity right now. Please try again later; your key and settings are kept.
settings.reconnectHint: This replaces both the computer token and the cloud sandbox token: the old computer disconnects and a running sandbox restarts for a few dozen seconds
settings.sandboxRolled: The cloud sandbox is using the new token and is restarting
settings.rotateHint: The old tokens stop working right away; the new token is shown once and a running sandbox switches automatically.

settings.noticeRestored: Restored: the sandbox is starting and your earlier work is kept. Your local link does not need a new token.
settings.noticeDeleted: Removed: the sandbox is stopped and your work is kept. Start it again when needed; no new token is issued.
settings.noticeRotated: The old token is revoked. On your computer, choose "Reissue token" in the tray to give the local link the new one.
settings.confirmRotate: This replaces both the computer token and the cloud sandbox token: the old computer disconnects and a running sandbox restarts for a few dozen seconds. Continue?
settings.confirmDelete: Removing stops the sandbox (your work is kept) and sessions pause until you start it again. Remove it?
settings.copyManual: Automatic copying is unavailable. The text is selected; press Ctrl+C.
settings.agentTokenHint: Run this command in local PowerShell, then paste the token into the hidden prompt.
settings.lead: Register your own model key and set the model and approval policy for new conversations.
settings.machineEntryHint: The cloud sandbox only starts, updates and is removed here. Connecting a computer is in My computer below.

home.title: What do you want to work out today?

chat.name: Chat
chat.what: Question and answer. It can query our data; it does not touch files on your machine.

work.name: Work
work.what: Let it act in your project folder: read files, run commands, change files. You approve what matters.

expert.name: Expert
expert.what: Follows a fixed method step by step, checks every step, and writes the deliverable into the project files. Slower and costlier.

pick.chat: A chat does not need a project. With one, it can read the files in that project.

agent.failed: Could not reach the local link on this computer. Try again later.
agent.remote: You are not on the computer with the local link: the project is made on that computer, relayed through the cloud.
agent.remoteOutdated: Update the local link on that computer to 0.5.2 to create projects from another computer.

auth.title: This repository needs a login
auth.lead: Git on your computer has no login for this repository. Enter an access token: it goes only to the local link on your computer, for this clone, never through our servers.
auth.remember: Remember on this computer (saved by the computer's git credential manager; not asked again)
auth.remoteLead: Git on that computer has no login for this repository. Fill it in on that computer, or enter an access token here: it is relayed through the cloud to the local link on that computer, used once and not stored. Use a short-lived token limited to this repository.

page.lead: A project is a folder on your computer, plus what you chatted about, worked on, and what experts handed back around it.
page.offlineNote: The local link on this computer is not connected: you can look and chat, but not start work or ask an expert.
page.empty: Nothing in this project yet. Start with the three buttons above.
page.archiveBody: Once archived it no longer appears in the sidebar and the project list. Conversations and handbacks stay and it can be unarchived. Files on your computer are not affected.
page.problem: It did not work. Please try again.
page.noHandbacks: No expert has handed back yet. Deliverables live in the project files.

what.decide_missing: decide about what did not arrive

machines.title: Computer, link, sandbox and token
machines.lead: Work and Expert read and write projects on your own computer. The local link runs there and lets us touch only the folders you whitelisted.
machines.elsewhere: This is the computer connected to your account. If you are on a different computer now, install and connect it with the three steps below; {name} then disconnects, because an account drives one computer at a time.
machines.offlineNote: The local link is not connected. Check "Status and reason" in the tray on that computer; with "Run at logon" on, it starts after you log in.
machines.removeFailed: Not removed. A connected computer cannot be removed; if it is offline, refresh and try again.
machines.noRoots: No folder added yet. Add one in the local link so projects have a place.

ceiling.title: The limits this machine sets for itself

sandbox.workspace-write: can change files only inside whitelisted folders

ceiling.note: These can only be changed on that machine. The web page shows them and cannot change them; however much we allow, it cannot go beyond them.

guide.title: Connect a computer
guide.connect: After installing, your computer opens this page with the confirmation code filled in; check the computer name and allow it to issue the local link's token
guide.evidence: A connected local link means these three steps are done.
guide.onlineHint: Status updates every 5 seconds. Return to Work or Expert once the local link is connected.

connect.title: Connect a computer
connect.hint: Eight characters. They are uppercased and a hyphen is inserted after the fourth. If this page did not open by itself, type the code shown on your computer here.
connect.prefilled: The confirmation code came from your computer. Make sure the computer below is yours, then allow it.
connect.wrong: The code is wrong or expired
connect.intoAccount: After you allow this, the local link on this computer gets the token of the account "{account}". If that is not the right account, deny, sign in with the right one and issue again.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.unlock: After downloading, right-click the ZIP, open Properties, check Unblock, extract, then double-click Install. This is not the main path.
advanced.copyFailed: Copy did not succeed. Try again.

setup.downloadFailed: Download information could not be loaded. No sandbox or token was changed.
setup.copyHint: Paste it into PowerShell and press Enter. It works for 10 minutes and only once
setup.tooFast: That was too fast. Wait and try again
setup.packageInfo: Version {version} · Codex {codex} · Windows x64 · Download {size} MiB
setup.installHint: Save the ZIP as windows-x64.zip in Downloads and run this in ordinary PowerShell. Verify the source and hashes first. An existing destination stops installation. Do not disable system protection if blocked.
setup.developmentOnly: Development-site package. Clean Windows and real reboot acceptance are still pending before public release.
setup.startTitle: Choose directories and start after initialization
setup.startHint: Complete local initialization above, then open tray settings, add and select project directories, save and start. Logon startup is an explicit tray option.
setup.oneMachine: An account is assigned to one local link at a time; issuing a token on another computer disconnects the old one.
setup.unknownExpiry: Not issued or a legacy token with no recorded expiry
setup.refreshRequired: The identity changed or an operation is still running. Status was refreshed. Review it before explicitly trying again; no automatic rotation occurs.
setup.needKey: Register a model key in Settings first, then create your sandbox to receive the first token.
setup.operationFailed: Operation not confirmed ({code}). Check status before retrying. If the first token was lost, explicitly request a replacement.
setup.statusFailed: Status could not be loaded. Actions are disabled; refresh the page to retry.
setup.tokenCopied: Copied. Paste only into the hidden local initialization prompt; clear the clipboard afterwards.
setup.tokenMemory: Shown on this page once, cleared after five minutes, navigation or refresh. Do not paste into chat or command arguments. Copying uses the system clipboard; avoid cross-device clipboard synchronization.
setup.afterInit: The command prompts for hidden token input locally. Then follow the next step, “Choose directories and start after initialization”.

machines.loadFailed: Computer status could not be loaded; whether the local link is connected is unknown.

computerConnection.welcome: First add your model key in Settings, then connect your computer so Work and Expert can read and write your files.

memory.title: Long-term memory
memory.intro: These lines go at the start of every conversation you have. Only you can see them. Write facts about yourself: what you follow, which figures you use, how you like answers.
memory.addPlaceholder: e.g. For banks use pre-provision profit; answer conclusion first
memory.examples: Sectors and companies you follow, metric preferences, risk appetite, output habits

settings.title: Settings

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.lead: These live in this browser only; another browser starts fresh.

cloud.title: Models
cloud.lead: Model keys and base URL, defaults for new conversations, the data sources Codex may use, and long-term memory. They follow your account on any computer.
cloud.memoryHint: A few facts about you, carried into every conversation.

computer.localLead: Folders, limits and run at logon live in the local link on your computer. Changes made here go straight to that computer, not through the cloud; widening changes (adding a folder, raising the limit, enabling network, turning on run at logon) need one confirmation on that computer, after which the local link restarts itself.
computer.readOnlyFrom: Below is what the local link last reported (read-only):
computer.addRootPlaceholder: Absolute path on the computer, e.g. D:\research

sandbox.workspace-write: Write only inside the whitelisted folders

computer.confirmOnComputer: This widens access: enter the code in the confirmation window on the computer and allow it.
computer.saved: Saved. The local link is restarting; this refreshes in a few seconds.

failure.local_denied: Not allowed on the computer; nothing changed.
failure.busy: The local link is busy (maybe restarting); try again shortly.
failure.invalid: One item is not acceptable (folder missing, duplicated, or more than 32); nothing changed.
failure.no_agent_here: The local link on this computer is gone; nothing was sent.
failure.ticket_invalid: The local access ticket was not accepted; reload and try again.

status.title: Status now
status.none: No local link has a token for this account yet.
status.reissueHint: To reissue the token: choose "Reissue token" in the tray on that computer, then check the confirmation code and account on the page that opens and allow it.
status.needKey: Register a model key under Models, then start the sandbox.
status.paired: Paired: the local link is connected and the sandbox is ready.
status.missingLink: the local link is not connected

settings.baseUrlHint: A self-hosted or proxied OpenAI-compatible endpoint; https only, no local or private addresses. Leave empty for the vendor default.

panes.side: Drag to resize the right panel
panes.hint: Drag to resize; double-click to reset

sessionRecovery.title: Your sign-in is no longer valid
sessionRecovery.hint: Your unsent input remains on this page. Sign in in a new tab, then return here to continue. Check the result of your last action; confirmations and collection requests will not be retried automatically.
sessionRecovery.login: Sign in in a new tab
sessionRecovery.resume: I signed in; return to this page
sessionRecovery.failed: A valid sign-in could not be confirmed. Finish signing in and try again.
sessionRecovery.accountChangedHint: The previous account’s cached pages and unsent input have been cleared. Reopen this page to continue.

requestFailure.authentication: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in to continue.
requestFailure.forbidden: This account does not have access to this content.
requestFailure.notFound: This content does not exist or has been removed.
requestFailure.contract: The service returned an unexpected data format. Retry, or report the problem if it persists.
requestFailure.unavailable: The service is unavailable. Please try again later.
requestFailure.capabilityReauth: The connection credential expired or lacks access. Verify or replace it in Connections & tools, then reconfirm this selection.
requestFailure.capability: Capability configuration or authorization is not ready. Check the connection, skill dependencies and current selection before retrying.
requestFailure.changed: These settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.

capabilities.connectionsLead: Manage service accounts and MCP tools shared by chat and work. Each action is authorized separately.
capabilities.skillsLead: Imported, enabled Skills are automatically discoverable in chat and work. Instructions and resources load on demand; no per-conversation selection is required.
capabilities.runtimeUnavailable: The remote tool execution endpoint is not configured. Skills remain available; an administrator must configure remote execution.
capabilities.empty: No capabilities yet. Add a connection or import a skill.
capabilities.dependencyDeclarationHint: Declare required services and tools here. This does not bind an account or grant access; choose accounts in this run's capabilities.
capabilities.dependencyUnknownTool: The original connection tool is unavailable

dependencyStatus.available: Accounts available; choose one when using this Skill
dependencyStatus.selected: Tool selected for this run; operations still require approval
dependencyStatus.selection_required: Select this connection tool for the current run
dependencyStatus.connection_required: Connect a service account that provides this tool
dependencyStatus.connection_inactive: Related connections are disabled or disconnected

capabilities.disconnectWarning: Disconnecting blocks new calls across conversations and removes stored credentials. Requests already sent may still complete.
capabilities.defaultHint: Defaults affect new conversations only. Disable blocks new calls; disconnect also removes credentials. Completed operations are not undone.
capabilities.name: Connection name
capabilities.noServices: No reviewed MCP services are configured. An administrator must add a service. This form cannot start arbitrary commands.
capabilities.token: Bearer / API token (leave empty for unauthenticated services)
capabilities.connectionHint: Credentials are encrypted on the backend. Connection checks discover tools without sending mail or making business changes. OAuth requires a supported service adapter.
capabilities.skillName: Skill identifier (letters, numbers, underscore or hyphen)
capabilities.fileError: Choose UTF-8 Markdown up to 64 KiB or a Skill ZIP up to 2 MiB.
capabilities.packageReady: Selected {filename}. Instructions and resources will be validated on import. Enter a name, description and version.
capabilities.skillDiscoveryHint: Automatic mode exposes names and descriptions only. The model reads instructions and resources on demand. Newly enabled Skills become discoverable on the next turn without granting tool permissions.
capabilities.skillHint: Import instructions or a Skill ZIP with reference files. ZIP requires SKILL.md at its root: up to 256 files, 4 MiB total uncompressed, 512 KiB per file. The model reads selected package resources on demand; scripts are not executed automatically. Import updates as new versions.
capabilities.selectionHint: Select connection tools explicitly. Skills are discovered automatically unless you restrict this conversation. Changes apply next turn and do not start a task.
capabilities.methodFrozen: A frozen method controls this conversation. Legacy methods do not declare managed connections or skills and cannot inherit additional chat capabilities.
capabilities.actionHint: External actions require an exact approval. Check targets and content in all parameters; permission applies once.
capabilities.unknownOutcome: Dispatch is in progress or its outcome is unknown. Check the provider before retrying.
capabilities.revokeAtProvider: Platform access was removed. Revoke the original credential at the provider if necessary; remote revocation is not supported for this credential type.

issue.connection_unavailable: A selected connection is unavailable. Reconnect or remove it.
issue.operation_unavailable: This tool's operation and resource scope need review or have changed. It is unavailable; contact the administrator.
issue.skill_unavailable: A selected skill is unavailable. Check its status.
issue.revision_changed: A capability revision changed. Review and save the selection again.
issue.missing_dependencies: Select the tools required by the skill.
issue.runtime_unconfigured: The remote execution endpoint is not configured.
issue.method_bindings_required: Bind every declared MCP tool and Skill before running this step
issue.outside_method_scope: The selected capability is outside this step contract
issue.ambiguous_method_binding: Bind exactly one account or Skill version per requirement
issue.method_permission_unconfirmed: Review and confirm the method permissions before saving bindings.
issue.method_permission_revoked: Method permissions were revoked. Confirm again at an idle step.

capabilities.conversationCapabilitiesExcluded: Affected capabilities are excluded from this turn. Chat and work that do not need them can continue.
capabilities.methodCapabilitiesBlocked: Required capabilities are not ready. Resolve these issues before this step can continue.
capabilities.renewHint: Verify this connection with a new credential. Empty means no authentication. Reconfirm conversation selections afterward.
capabilities.methodManagedUnavailable: This expert uses platform tools from its frozen contract. Binding newly registered external connections and skills is not supported yet; conversation selections do not enter its steps.
capabilities.methodBindingHint: Bind existing accounts and installed Skills to this step. Only declared capabilities are offered. Save at an idle step boundary before retrying.
capabilities.repositoryHint: Use a public GitHub repository, directory, or SKILL.md URL. Review the complete package before installation. For private repositories, import a file.
capabilities.noSkillsFound: No SKILL.md found here. Check the URL or import a file.
capabilities.installCompatibility: Installed Skills are enabled for chat, work, and method steps. Review their requirements: MCP connections and action permissions need separate configuration. Instructions and reference reading are supported.
capabilities.scriptsNotSupported: This package contains scripts. Files are preserved, but package scripts cannot currently run; features requiring them are unavailable.
capabilities.uninstallWarning: Uninstalling blocks further use in conversations and method steps. Past call records and version contents are retained. Active tasks may need reconfiguration.
capabilities.scriptsSupported: Python, Shell and Node scripts can run in an isolated cloud container, without network or local project access. Additional dependencies require separate setup.
capabilities.scriptRunning: The script is running in an isolated container. Results update automatically.
capabilities.scriptTimeout: The script reached its time limit and was stopped.
capabilities.scriptTruncated: Output exceeded the size limit and was truncated.
capabilities.methodPermissionConfirmHint: Confirming permits the current step to request only these accounts, resources and purposes for up to 24 hours. External operations still require individual approval.
capabilities.methodRevokeHint: Revoke the method permissions confirmed for this task, stopping further access by its steps and child calls. Operations already sent cannot be undone.
